title: For an abelian etale sheaf on Spec K whose geometric stalk identifies equivariantly with a discrete Galois representation M, its sheaf cohomology in every degree is equivalent to continuous cohomology of M.
statement:
For an abelian etale sheaf on Spec K whose geometric stalk identifies equivariantly with a discrete Galois representation M, its sheaf cohomology in every degree is equivalent to continuous cohomology of M. The precise hypotheses and action-on-germs formula are recorded by the following Lean signature: theorem nonempty_equiv_etale_cohomology_continuous_stalk
    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (F : Sheaf (Spec (.of K)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (M : TopRep.{u} ℤ (Gal(Ks/K))) [DiscreteTopology M]
    (c : ((pointSmallEtale
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).sheafFiber
      (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj F
      ≃+ M)
    (hc : ∀ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
      (hτ : (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
        τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω))
      (X : (Spec (.of K)).Etale)
      (x x' : (pointSmallEtale
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).fiber.obj X)
      (hx : x'.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ x.left)
      (z : F.obj.obj (op X)),
      c ((pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).toPresheafFiber
        X x' F.obj z) =
      M.ρ g (c ((pointSmallEtale
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).toPresheafFiber X x F.obj z)))
    (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (Sheaf.H.{u + 1} F n ≃ continuousCohomology n M)

proof.text: Obtain the abelian geometric stalk equivalence E, its underlying additive stalk comparison i, and its action-on-germs formula. Choose the identity etale terminal object T and evaluation V at T.
Identify V naturally with invariants of E by the degree-zero global sections lemma. Compose i_F with c to obtain an additive equivalence d from E(F) to M.

Prove d is equivariant: extend g to an automorphism tau of Omega, represent i_F(z) by a germ using joint surjectivity, and form the transported geometric lift xprime by Spec(tau). The canonical action formula and hc identify both sides. Apply i_F inverse to the germ identity to recover z.

Form the natural isomorphism from evaluation V to invariants using the additive equivalences t and ht. Convert d to its canonical integer-linear equivalence and apply the existing discrete-invariants continuous comparison. This gives an equivalence from right-derived evaluation to homogeneous continuous cohomology of M, with no finite-ring hypothesis.

For positive degrees, identify Sheaf.H with right-derived evaluation using the existing injective-resolution comparison. In degree zero, compose Sheaf.H.equiv0 with the inverse of rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf. Compose the additive equivalences and forget additivity to obtain the required Nonempty equivalence.
